process_release.scope: Observed PID/start-time identities, their descendants, and identity-anchored process groups only. Unobserved double forks or namespace escapes are not fully proved absent; complete arbitrary-program containment requires a job cgroup.

runtime_diagnostics.cold_definition: first observed shape/phase for a worker, or adapter-supplied cold flag; CLI starts are independently cold
runtime_diagnostics.idle_attribution_limit: sampled activity below 10% grouped by the contemporaneous controller observation; context is diagnostic evidence, not proof of exclusive causation
runtime_diagnostics.throughput_note: stage completions are not scientific task completions; use terminal workflow provenance and score/decision parity

cpu_cost_note: sampling can miss short-lived children; this is a lower bound
gpu_activity_note: device-wide activity includes other jobs if allocation is not exclusive
